title: World BEYOND War Europe current network page

data.notes: Current first-party Europe page states the WBW Europe Network was born in 2024 and is composed of WBW chapters, affiliates, and allies in Europe. It currently lists Ireland, Romania, Berlin, and International Peacefactory Wanfried under Chapters.

title: World BEYOND War Berlin chapter page

data.notes: Current first-party Berlin chapter page identifies the Berlin chapter, documents chapter campaigns and mailing-list/contact surfaces, and links historical first-party material identifying Heinrich Buecker as a Berlin chapter leader.

title: World BEYOND War podcast with Berlin chapter leader Heinrich Buecker

data.notes: First-party 2021 podcast article identifies Heinrich Buecker as a World BEYOND War Berlin chapter leader and says he had been running the Berlin chapter since 2015. Current 2026 role status was not independently established in this pass.

title: World BEYOND War International Peacefactory Wanfried chapter page

data.notes: Current first-party page lists International Peacefactory Wanfried as a WBW chapter, describes its physical peace-education and organizing space in Wanfried, Germany, and links its independent website.

title: World BEYOND War volunteer spotlight: Christian Neie-Marwede

data.notes: First-party November 25, 2024 profile states Christian Neie-Marwede participated in International Peace Factory Wanfried activities, helped moderate the Wanfried section of #NoWar2024, worked on networking among European WBW chapters and affiliates, and joined the international section of the Romania for Peace chapter.
